name: Deepak V.
text: Great workshop in Morazha. Got my oil and filters replaced with a clear written estimate up front.

name: Akhil K.
text: Got my car bodywork and bumper denting repaired here after a scrape near Kannapuram. Paint finish matches the factory shade perfectly. They gave a clear written quote before touching the car.

name: Rahul M.
text: AC stopped cooling on my Swift during peak heat. Diagnosed the compressor coil issue in 10 minutes, gave me the exact price, and fixed it the same afternoon.

name: Sreejith P.
text: Very transparent garage in Morazha. Showed me the worn suspension bushes before replacing them. No surprise items added to the final bill.
